title: Handling of Small data rate control

entities.name: Small data rate control
entities.description: Controls the maximum number of uplink user data messages including uplink exception data reporting sent by the UE in a time interval for a PDU session. Applicable only to NB-N1 mode and WB-N1 mode.

entities.name: Small data rate control parameters
entities.description: Parameters provided by the network to control the rate of uplink user data messages. Includes parameters for exception data reporting.

entities.name: Small data rate control parameters for exception data
entities.description: Specific parameters controlling the rate of uplink exception data reports, provided alongside general small data rate control parameters.

entities.name: Initial small data rate control parameters
entities.description: Parameters provided during PDU session establishment, representing the remaining small data rate control status from a previously released session.

entities.name: CIoT 5GS optimizations
entities.description: Condition where the UE indicates support for CIoT 5GS optimizations, enabling the network to provide small data rate control parameters.

entities.name: Allowed indication of additional exception reports
entities.description: Condition allowing the UE to send uplink exception reports even if the general small data rate control limit has been reached.

entities.name: Small data rate control status
entities.description: Stored status of small data rate control parameters, maintained during PDU session release or inter-system changes for reuse in subsequent sessions.

entities.name: PDU session release procedure
entities.description: Procedure during which the network may store the small data rate control status for a released PDU session.

entities.name: PDU session establishment procedure
entities.description: Procedure during which the network may provide initial small data rate control parameters based on stored status.

entities.name: Inter-system change from N1 mode to S1 mode
entities.description: Procedure during which the UE stores the current small data rate control status for PDU sessions being transferred.

entities.name: Inter-system change from S1 mode to N1 mode
entities.description: Procedure during which the UE uses stored small data rate control status for transferred PDU sessions, if valid.

relations.description: Small data rate control procedure uses parameters provided by the network.
Small data rate control parameters may include specific parameters for exception data reporting.
Provision of small data rate control parameters is conditional on UE support for CIoT 5GS optimizations.
Allowed indication of additional exception reports governs the use of exception data parameters.
PDU session release procedure may result in storage of small data rate control status.
PDU session establishment procedure may include initial small data rate control parameters.
Stored small data rate control status is used to derive initial parameters for new sessions.
Inter-system change from N1 to S1 mode triggers storage of small data rate control status.
Inter-system change from S1 to N1 mode uses stored small data rate control status if valid.
